summary.text: Pat Grassley is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 57 who has served as Speaker of the Iowa House since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia notes that Grassley was first elected to the House in 2006 and is a farmer by experience.

paragraphs.text: Pat Grassley was born in 1983 in Cedar Falls, Iowa, and earned an associate degree in agribusiness from Hawkeye Community College, according to Ballotpedia.

Grassley's experience includes being a farmer, a member of the Butler County Farm Bureau, and a member of the Oak Hill Cemetery Foundation Board, and Ballotpedia notes that Grassley is the grandson of U.S. Sen. Chuck Grassley (R).
Grassley was first elected to the Iowa House in 2006, at age 23.
Grassley chaired the House Agriculture Committee in the 2013 and 2015 legislative sessions and the House Appropriations Committee in the 2017 and 2019 sessions.
The Iowa House elected Grassley as Speaker ahead of the 2020 legislative session, and Grassley assumed that office on January 13, 2020.
